## What to build

Persistent display policy, manual overrides and reconnect. Deliver the complete operator behavior through the shared Wake controller and terminal boundary. Owner: ecochran76, coordinated by primary agent. Delivery: validated integration branch; no production deployment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Global/workspace policy and opt-out persist through process restart with CLI/API/MCP parity.
- [ ] User style edits pause only affected decoration scope while observation continues; explicit resume restores policy.
- [ ] Reconnecting clients regain decoration without bypassing manual holds or rollback disable.
- [ ] Reset/inspect/configure behavior documents baseline retention; original baseline survives reenable/restart.
